title: Bismuth recurring at S4

tellings.quote: There's a reason why Bob Lazar kept hearing about it at S4. [music]
take one like bismouth I think which I think comes up a lot in sort of UFO lore
tellings.difference: Speaks of UFO lore in general and does not name S4.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of bismuth recurring in UFO lore through Bob Lazar and S4.

plain: Bismuth, a heavy metal, keeps coming up in UFO stories, and Michels says there is a reason a man named Bob Lazar kept hearing about it at S4, a secret site in Nevada where Lazar says he worked in the late 1980s. Michels tells this himself in two episodes; in the second he speaks of bismuth in UFO lore in general and does not name S4. He brings it up because, if true, the metal may have a real part in how such craft are said to work.
